rules.reason: One business implementation per operation is the same obligation as IF-02: adapters do not implement business rules.
Every interface calls the operation is the IF-01 adapter call contract.
Authorization inside the operation is OPS-07.
No transport types in core and operation is ARC-03.
SSO addition leaves existing operation signatures and business references unchanged; CONF-42 states the same regression obligation.
A token for one interface is rejected by another; AUTH-08 fixes the audience rule.
No side effect before authorization succeeds is the same obligation as OPS-06.
